page.overview:
Who is Kenny Omega?

Tyson Smith (born October 16, 1983), better known by the ring name Kenny Omega (Japanese: ケニー・オメガ, Hepburn: Kenī Omega), is a Canadian-born professional wrestler. He is signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW), where he is also an executive vice president, and the reigning AEW International Champion in his first reign. Omega played Cody in his Street Fighter V character trailer, revealed Rose in the Summer Update 2020 video, and portrayed Sagat, C. Viper, Ingrid and Alex for Street Fighter 6's Season 3 trailer.

Kenny Omega has payed homage to Street Fighter throughout his wrestling career, either through ring attire, wrestling moves, or music. Omega's signature moves include You Can't Escape, a fireman's carry followed by a moonsault, named after Alex's quote when performing a Super Art, and V-Trigger, a running knee strike. During his time at DDT Pro-Wrestling, Omega used the Hadoken as a double palm strike while yelling the attack's name. At AEW Fyter Fest 2019, an event co-sponsored by fighting game event CEO, Omega and his partners The Young Bucks (Matt and Nick Jackson) dressed as Akuma, Ryu, and Ken respectively, coming out to Street Fighter II's title music.

At Tokyo Game Show 2023, Kenny Omega was approached by Capcom to film promotional material for Street Fighter 6 in cosplay. Initially, Capcom had wanted to include some of Omega's mannerisms in Alex's animations as thanks for his cooperation, however Omega offered to provide motion capture as well. The shoot took roughly eleven hours and included AEW professional wrestler [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Nakazawa Michael Nakazawa] as support.

Alex's alternate Level 2 Super Art Omega Wing Buster, performed after an OD Power Drop, features Omega's finger point taunt and V-Trigger knee strike, followed by his finisher, One-Winged Angel, a one-handed electric chair driver. During the animation, a dark burst of energy emerges from Alex's side in the shape of a wing, referencing Final Fantasy VII antagonist Sephiroth, whose theme is the namesake of the technique. The preceding OD Power Drop also references Omega's Snap Dragon Suplex.
